overall_goal: Add and saute chopped onions, then measure and add garlic and ginger paste to the pan.

goals.description: Add chopped onions to the frying pan and saute them.
goals.rationale: The person retrieves the bowl of chopped onions, adds them to the frying pan, and repeatedly sautes them until they are golden brown.

goals.description: Measure and add garlic paste to the frying pan.
goals.rationale: The person prepares the weighing balance, opens the garlic paste jar, measures the paste with a spoon, and adds it to the pan.

goals.description: Measure and add ginger paste to the frying pan and mix the ingredients.
goals.rationale: The person opens the ginger paste jar, measures the paste, adds it to the pan, and mixes all the contents together.
